Definition: ; a prolonged form of πίω; which (together with another form) πόω; occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses; to imbibe (literally or figuratively):--drink.
BiblicalUsage: Pino means to drink — water, wine, or a cup given by God. Jesus promises living water so that whoever drinks shall never thirst, in John 4:14, and says we must drink His blood to have life in John 6:53. At the table He says, Drink ye all of it, in Matthew 26:27, and in Gethsemane He takes the cup from the Father in John 18:11. Paul warns we cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of devils in 1 Corinthians 10:21.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe drinking is the Bible's picture of receiving — what I drink becomes part of me. That is why I hold that the cup I take decides the life I live.
RelatedEvents: The Last Supper; Jesus Prays in Gethsemane
